remarks: Behind a classic white ranch-rail fence on a picturesque, tree-lined street sits this 1936 storybook ranch home that looks straight out of a country postcard. Barn-red board-and-batten siding, crisp white shutters, and a welcoming front porch trimmed in delicate white lattice set the tone for the farmhouse charm that continues throughout. Offering 3 bedrooms and 2 baths across approximately 2,072 square feet, the home blends vintage character with comfortable everyday living. Sun-filled rooms, warm farmhouse-style details, and an inviting flow make it easy to feel right at home from the moment you step through the door. The generous 9,067 SF lot is a rare find. Out back, a spacious backyard
